top_signals.title: Bitcoin advocacy group to join US State Department’s ‘digital freedom’ program
top_signals.summary: The Bitcoin Policy Institute and three partner organizations will be able to send employees to work alongside State Department officials to address issues including digital freedom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: GitHub, PyPI add time-based defenses against supply chain attacks
top_signals.summary: GitHub and PyPI (Python Package Index) have introduced a time-based mechanism in the Dependabot dependency management tool to protect against supply-chain attacks and to limit their impact. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
